items.item: Every field has a visible label above it; no placeholder is used as the label
items.evidence: Each form field has <label for=...> above it (customer, issue, terms, due, ref, notes). Placeholder 'Optional' on #ref is only a hint. Line-item cells rely on column headers plus aria-label; Discount input sits beside its dt label (not above), a minor deviation.

items.item: Field widths match the expected input (dates and quantities are narrow)
items.evidence: Dates sit in a 4-column grid (lg:grid-cols-4, about 160px), Qty column is w-[10%] and #disc is w-16; Customer select is full width.

items.item: Required fields are marked with an asterisk
items.evidence: * on Customer, Invoice date and Due date labels.

items.item: Line items can be added and removed; quantities, prices and amounts are right-aligned with tabular figures
items.evidence: #addRow -> addRow(); .del handler removes the row. Inputs .qty/.price use 'text-right tabular-nums'; td.amt is 'text-right tabular-nums'; the audit reports numericCells misaligned 0, nonTabular 0.

items.item: Subtotal, tax and total are computed and right-aligned with locale currency formatting
items.evidence: recalc() fills #tSub, #tTax, #tTotal. Values are right-aligned (flex justify-between, tabular-nums). fmt() uses toLocaleString('en-US', 2 decimals) with a hard-coded '$', not Intl currency style.

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with three or more errors a summary appears and focus moves to the first error
items.evidence: There are no blur/focusout listeners. validate() runs only on submit ('Sent'), and 'Save as draft' skips validation. The banner says only 'Please fix the highlighted fields before saving.' with no error list. Focus is never moved to the first error (only window.scrollTo top). The issue-date and missing-due-date errors have no message elements.

items.item: Save is not disabled before submitting; it is disabled only while the submission is in progress
items.evidence: The Save button is never disabled. save() is synchronous with no in-progress state, so a double click submits twice and there is no pending/disabled handling.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable in a sticky bar, and leaving with unsaved changes asks for confirmation
items.evidence: Buttons are inside the aside summary card (lg:sticky lg:top-6), which is a sticky side card at lg only, not a bar. Below lg they sit at the end of the page. Cancel always runs confirm('Discard this invoice?') with no dirty-state tracking, and there is no beforeunload guard.

notes: Table header uses 'uppercase tracking-wide'. The #custInfo slate-50 bordered box sits inside the Customer card (mild card-in-card). Audit score 76: row height 52px (above 48), contrast failures on breadcrumb (4.34:1) and the '%' glyph (2.56:1), and 5 card drop shadows. Indigo accent on a plain slate/white layout, with no gradients, glass, emoji or hover-lift. 'Save invoice' fires validation but 'Save as draft' does not.
